nodes.author: Drtakyi
nodes.text: It is reassuring at this stage that the HMPV ( Human Metapneumo Virus) is not at the pandemic level and it’s not new. Let’s continue to use the barrier methods and hand sanitizers plus handwashing and Facemask especially when we have flu or in crowded spaces.
